name: REKATECH
recent: Rekatech 在2026年9月披露了2021年已完成的RM2.16m关联方房产收购，并于10月底发布2026年报及召开第22届常年股东大会的通知。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收环比增长178.4%，净亏损收窄至RM1.075m。
notable: 披露2021年1月19日已签订的关联方房产收购，总代价RM2,161,500。
发布2026财政年年报及企业治理报告。
将于2026年12月16日召开第22届常年股东大会。
risks: 关联方房产收购于2021年签约，但迟至2026年9月才披露。
FY2026净亏损RM2.45m，同时注销RM16.76m应收款项。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收RM2.035m，环比增长178.4%，同比增长38.6%；净亏损RM1.075m，净利率-52.8%，较上季的-70.0%有所改善。

recent_en: Rekatech disclosed in September 2026 a RM2.16m related-party property acquisition completed in 2021, and in late October issued its FY2026 annual report and notice for the 22nd AGM. For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 178.4% QoQ while net loss narrowed to RM1.075m.
notable_en: Disclosed a related-party property acquisition with total consideration of RM2,161,500, under sale and purchase agreements dated 19 January 2021.
Released the FY2026 Annual Report and Corporate Governance Report.
Convened the 22nd Annual General Meeting for 16 December 2026.
risks_en: The related-party property acquisition was signed in 2021 but only disclosed in September 2026.
FY2026 net loss of RM2.45m alongside a RM16.76m write-off of receivables.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM2.035m, up 178.4% QoQ and 38.6% YoY; net loss was RM1.075m with a net margin of -52.8%, improving from -70.0% in the prior quarter.
